fork_status_and_schedule.highlight: Glamsterdam devnet 7 stable for 20 days; 90%+ participation, minor disk/node issues
Glamsterdam devnet 8 targets new CSpec release; should be short-lived named testnet with updated repricing

repricing_updates.highlight: New anchor lowered from 100 to 75 Mgas/s due to costlier account test cases; 21K ETH transfer is hard ceiling
EIP-8038: account writes increase 8K→9K; SLOAD stays at 2,100 (no increase from current); ETransfers EIP unchanged
At 75 Mgas/s anchor: Erigon still red/yellow (optimizations pending); ethrex has one cold-access gap; Besu/Geth at edge but expected to improve
At 75 Mgas/s, theoretical max block limit ~450M gas; 300M considered safely reachable if all clients reach green

epbs_attestation_deadline.highlight: ePBS makes worst-case slow blocks an automatic reorg attack; worst-case sizing must be respected, not average
Attestation deadline lowering to 2s: main blocker was one operator combining high min-bid with timing games on Prysm
Decision: keep attestation deadline at 3s for fork; gather hard numbers post-fork, revisit lowering to 2s without a hard fork

el_breakout_discv5.highlight: discv5-only mode confirmed for devnet 8; all clients passing on at least one branch; fallback must be disabled
Two clients lacked a flag to disable discv4 fallback (Nimbus EL confirmed); teams asked to add the flag before devnet 8

el_breakout_block_access_lists.highlight: Block Access Lists (EIP-8189) enable hot-booting SnapSync: pre-loading last N blocks' access items into cache cuts cold-read penalty
Snap2 healing phase can replace trie healing with BAL execution; ~79% of first-touch items touched in prior 256 blocks
Consensus: BAL hot-boot is a nice-to-have post-release optimization; does not affect worst-case benchmark numbers

el_breakout_eip_7702.highlight: EIP-7702 engine API mandatory endpoints raised; Geth and Nethermind passing Hive simulator; concerns about FCU placement unresolved
Action: check with potuz on spec changes, then agenda EIP-7702 engine API discussion for ACDC

action_items.action: Update EIP-8038 repricing numbers; publish new execution-specs release
EthPandaOps: gather hard block-propagation and state-transition timing numbers at fork for 2s attestation deadline analysis
Confirm EIP-7702 engine API spec changes with potuz; bring to ACDC agenda

decisions.decision: Repricing numbers frozen: SLOAD stays at 2,100; account writes set to 9K; anchor fixed at 75 Mgas/s; all EL clients approved
Attestation deadline stays at 3s for Glamsterdam fork; 2s lowering deferred post-fork via coordinated client release
discv5-only (no discv4 fallback) adopted for devnet 8 and targeted for mainnet

targets.target: Glamsterdam devnet 8: short-lived named testnet, dependent on repricing finalization this week
